title: Energy from trash: a flexible, facile, and robust triboelectric nanogenerator based on waste polystyrene and application as a human–machine interface
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4107-4115
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09473A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Raj Ankit, Pranav Prakash, Robin Singla, Jayant Kolte
Waste PS solution is processed into positive triboelectric layers through solution casting, electrospinning, and spray coating, resulting in smooth and nanostructured PS films to fabricate TENGs for energy harvesting and sensing applications.
